Two of the three sites are confirmed on today's `origin/main`:


⚠️ ⛔ **The third — `record:line_items` — this seat did NOT locate.** A grep of `$top:` across `packages/plugin-detail/src` returns `RelatedList.tsx:902` (`$top: ids.length`, a different shape) and four test fixtures. ⇒ the third site is **unread**, ⛔ not absent, and ⛔ not at the address a reader would assume. **Derive it; do not take the card's list of three on trust.**

### 2. ⚠️ A second thing this seat did NOT verify, and it shapes the fix

The family's earlier cards — objectui#9853 (`ObjectGrid`) and objectui#9897 (`ListView`) — landed 「read-point resolvers」 as their fix shape. ⛔ This seat did **not** establish that those landed as a **shared helper** a third site can import. What it did find is `savedViewLimit` at `packages/core/src/data-scope/element-data-source.ts:190` — and that is the **lowering layer**, which is objectui#9928's subject, ⛔ not a read-point resolver.

⇒ the dispatch requires the dev to **derive what the two landed cards actually did** before copying anything. ⛔ 「Do what #9853 did」 is not an instruction until someone has read what that was.

### 3. ⭐ The family's decided shape, relayed from objectui#9928's body — ⛔ re-measure before relying on it

objectui#9928 records that its own layer 「repairing here closes one of two entrances; the read-point resolvers close both」, and that objectui#9899 measured the decisive counter-fact: the same bad `$top` comes out of the same block **with no `dataSource` binding at all**, where the lowering layer is never involved. ⇒ read-point resolution is the shape that covers both entrances. **[CARD-CLAIM]** — ⛔ this seat re-ran none of it.

⚠️ And objectui#9928's own warning applies here too: **drop, clamp and refuse are three different answers**, and the read-point resolvers' answer (fail-soft to the site's own default, one loud diagnostic) was chosen for a **renderer**. These three sites are renderers, so that answer should carry — say so from the code, ⛔ not from this sentence.

### 4. In-flight and file face

Claimed beside this one: objectui#9950 → `plugin-list` / `plugin-view`; objectui#9884 → `plugin-form`. ⛔ Disjoint.

```
packages/plugin-kanban/src/**
packages/plugin-timeline/src/**
packages/plugin-detail/src/**
.changeset/*
```

⚠️ `packages/core/src/data-scope/element-data-source.ts` is **out of face** — it is objectui#9928's subject. Needing it is a stop-and-report.

Next: dispatch to one `os-dev`, one worktree.
